title: 已经投进去的币
style: 像素街机 · 路线选择

cues.zh: 你投了三枚不能退的代币，才发现这个游戏不太好玩。
cues.en: You spent three non-refundable tokens and found the game uninteresting.

cues.zh: 已经付出、现在收不回来的三枚币，是沉没成本。
cues.en: The three spent and unrecoverable tokens are sunk costs.

cues.zh: 继续玩，或者现在离开，它们都留在机器里。
cues.en: They stay in the machine whichever option you choose.

cues.zh: 真正会被下一步改变的是后面二十分钟。
cues.en: What your next choice can change is the next twenty minutes.

cues.zh: 继续玩能得到什么？把时间留给另一件事又能得到什么？
cues.en: What would continuing give you? What would doing something else give you?

cues.zh: 如果还有一张票能退，退回的金额要算进现在的选择。
cues.en: If a ticket is refundable, include that refund in today’s decision.

cues.zh: 违约代价、剩余乐趣和未来学习机会，也仍然相关。
cues.en: Switching costs, remaining enjoyment, and future learning can still matter.

cues.zh: 把画面停在现在。假如刚到这儿，你会怎么用剩下的时间？
cues.en: Pause at the present. If you had just arrived, how would you spend the remaining time?

cues.zh: 选择留下或转身，都用下一步的收获和代价作理由。
cues.en: Choose to stay or leave based on what the next step costs and offers.

sources.title: Arkes 与 Blumer：The Psychology of Sunk Cost
sources.note: 沉没成本效应的经典实验与现场研究。

sources.title: Thorsteinson 与 Billings：Progress Decisions Involving Time: Sunk Cost or Completion Effects
sources.note: 2024 年研究区分时间投入与完成进度，显示效应大小及任务差异。
